tooltip.arkhaven_core.ward: Protects a %s-block radius from explosions and meteors. Fuel: ward crystals.
message.arkhaven_core.ward.wrong_tier: Needs a ward crystal of tier %s or higher.
message.arkhaven_core.ward.status: Ward tier %s, radius %s, %s min of fuel — %s
message.arkhaven_core.hearth.placed: Hearth stone placed: no hostile spawns within %s blocks.
message.arkhaven_core.zone.0: ✦ Safe zone — all is calm here
message.arkhaven_core.forecast.title: — Star Atlas (disaster intensity: %s) —
message.arkhaven_core.forecast.shower_ye: A meteor shower is expected tonight ✨
message.arkhaven_core.forecast.rift_yes: The sky is restless: rifts may open tonight.
message.arkhaven_core.forecast.strike: Meteor strike: the sky is gathering strength — %s%%.
message.arkhaven_core.forecast.strike_un: No meteor strikes until you finish the "Meteors" quest (%s%%).
message.arkhaven_core.forecast.cooldown: Disasters at most once every 3 days. Next one possible in: %s h.
message.arkhaven_core.forecast.paused.va: Vacation mode: the world is resting.
message.arkhaven_core.forecast.paused.gr: Grace period: the first days are quiet.
message.arkhaven_core.event.shower.title: Meteor Shower!
message.arkhaven_core.event.shower.subti: Look up — and look for fallen stones
message.arkhaven_core.event.shower.tutor: First shower: just beauty and gifts
message.arkhaven_core.event.shower.chat: [Arkhaven] A meteor shower has begun. Small meteors fall in the wilds and leave meteoric dust. If one falls into water, a star carp might be there.
message.arkhaven_core.event.rift.title: Rift Night
message.arkhaven_core.event.rift.chat: [Arkhaven] Rifts have opened 60–130 blocks from you. Their mobs stay close and vanish at dawn. Survive one for rift shards. Tier II wards keep rifts from opening.
message.arkhaven_core.event.strike.title: Meteor Incoming!
message.arkhaven_core.event.strike.subti: A big meteor is falling — watch the sky
message.arkhaven_core.event.strike.tutor: Training meteor: it will land far from builds
message.arkhaven_core.event.strike.chat: [Arkhaven] A meteor approaches! The glowing column in the sky shows where it will land. A Ward Generator burns it up in the air.
message.arkhaven_core.event.strike.where: Impact site: X %s, Z %s. Time: %s min %s s.
message.arkhaven_core.event.tutorial_not: This is the first event of its kind — a safe tutorial. Details in the "Elements & Defence" chapter.
message.arkhaven_core.cmd.event_failed: Could not start event %s (needs a player and a suitable spot).
message.arkhaven_core.cmd.noplayers: No players online — events don't run.
